name: pocket-lody
description: Lody on a handheld: a Pocket applet for a team's coding-agent sessions, built on PocketUI

scripts.setup: git submodule update --init vendor/pocket-shell vendor/applets && git -C vendor/pocket-shell submodule update --init vendor/pocketjs && bun install --cwd vendor/pocket-shell/vendor/pocketjs --frozen-lockfile && bun tools/setup.ts
